description: Review holdings in one call ($0.25): up to 15 positions (symbol with valueUsd or quantity) and 5 on-chain tokens. Returns concentration, correlations, volatility and one-day 95% VaR from hourly on-chain data, the current decision per symbol, token risk verdicts, macro events in the next 24h, flags and a verdict (OK, REVIEW, HIGH_RISK). Use for existing holdings; for one new trade use pre_trade_check.

decisions.description: Include the live decision for each position

positions.description: Holdings: up to 15 objects with symbol and valueUsd or quantity

tokens.description: On-chain tokens to review: up to 5 objects with address, chain and valueUsd

name: check_portfolio
